notes.title: Updated Demo Now Live
notes.notes: [p]How's it going, Survivors! [/p][p]We’ve polished the halls, added a new coat of paint, and the demo is ready for another run - below are the full patch notes for the demo update: [/p][p][/p][h2][b]Fixes[/b][/h2][h3]UI & Menus[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed some UI glitches when playing on ultra-wide resolutions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the game UI would break after exiting certain menus using the Inventory button.[/p][/*][*][p]Several localization errors have been corrected.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Controls & Input[/h3][list][*][p]Dodges in the tutorial are now registered correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]“Swap Shoulder With Triggers”[/b] option now works as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where PS4/PS5 controller buttons didn’t respond correctly.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Audio & Visuals[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the game could remain permanently muted after skipping a cutscene.[/p][/*][*][p]Venalis now blinks correctly.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Others[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a critical bug that caused animation events to duplicate, leading to excessive damage from certain attacks and other unintended behaviors.[/p][/*][*][p]The map now sets the destination correctly when marking the second floor of the Main Hall.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Changes[/b][/h2][h3]Inventory & Items[/h3][list][*][p]Charms no longer take up inventory space.[/p][/*][*][p]Charms are now slightly more expensive.[/p][/*][*][p]The effect percentage of Charms has been reduced.[/p][/*][*][p]Items can now be discarded directly from the [b]“Inventory Full”[/b] window.[/p][/*][*][p]All grenades now have a maximum stack size of [b]2[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Grenades, melee, and disposable weapons now switch back to the previously used weapon instead of the infinite weapon.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an inventory expansion to the shop.[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked item spawn rates for better balance.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Economy[/h3][list][*][p]The shop price multiplier has been decreased to [b]1.3x[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Antiseptic Sprays now heal a full heart but cost more in the shop.[/p][/*][*][p]Bandages now heal half a heart.[/p][/*][*][p]Gold Coins are now awarded automatically when defeating enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]The amount of Gold Coins you can hold is now capped.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now buy 4 different types of weapons in the shop every run.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Movement & Combat[/h3][list][*][p]Camera rotation is no longer restricted while dodging.[/p][/*][*][p]The gamepad button layout has been adjusted to allow dodging while rotating the camera.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option to run by default.[/p][/*][*][p]Dodge stamina now recovers more quickly.[/p][/*][*][p]Player movement speed is now reduced when at low health.[/p][/*][*][p]When the player is burning, flames now extinguish automatically when entering or teleporting to a new room.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Fear Mechanics[/h3][list][*][p]Fear mechanics have been reworked: fear is no longer reduced by enemies, but by solving puzzles instead. Maintaining 100% fear causes you to lose half a heart every few seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]The Fear Potion has been removed.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the color scheme of the Possessed Armor to avoid confusion with fear-related mechanics.[/p][/*][*][p]Flying vases/barrels no longer increase your fear level.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies no longer perform fear attacks.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Enemies & Encounters[/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted Hugger behavior to make encounters more fair.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies now despawn once you leave a room.[/p][/*][*][p]Added better visual feedback to the Linked Spawn’s attack.[/p][/*][*][p]A stunned Kardo now has a random chance to expose its back.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Others[/h3][list][*][p]Added a tip clarifying that puzzle clues are always located in the same room as the puzzle.[/p][/*][*][p]The map info legend “Under Exploration” is now called “Unopened Containers” to avoid confusion.[/p][/*][*][p]Slight modifications were made to some puzzle rooms.[/p][/*][*][p]Smoothed out the difficulty curve between the early game and the Tree Key.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the hitboxes and timing of traps.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the bleeding mechanic.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Updated the tutorial to reflect recent changes.[/p][/*][*][p]All cinematics are now skipped by pressing the [b]“Back”[/b] button instead of the [b]“Pause”[/b] button.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]That’s all for now - but keep checking in for more news & updates from Rogue Mansion![/p][p]Your feedback keeps the mansion alive, so thank you for playing! And of course, if you want to share more - follow [b]Almenara Games [/b]and [b]Top Hat Studios [/b]to keep up with all things [b]Rogue Mansion[/b].[/p][p align="start"][u][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2FAlmenaraGames"]X - Almenara Games [/url][/u][/p][p align="start"][u][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2FTopHatStudiosEN"]X - Top Hat Studios [/url][/u][/p][p align="start"][u][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2F%40TopHatStudiosEN"]Top Hat Studios YouTube[/url][/u][/p][p align="start"][u][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FSYUgMfAE"]Top Hat Studios Official Discord Server [/url][/u][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Rogue Mansion Demo Launching August 25th!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Survivors![/p][p]We’re thrilled to announce that the [b]Rogue Mansion demo[/b] will be launching on [b]August 25th[/b]! Step into the ever-shifting halls of the mansion, where every death reshuffles the rooms and corridors, puzzles, traps, and terrifying foes await. No two runs are ever the same, so prepare yourself for a survival horror experience like no other.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44367794/b5864704cfcdfeca2d98af4d364f4479f4e73c1e.png"][/img][/p][p]In the demo, you can play as [b]two unique survivors[/b] (out of four planned for the full release):[/p][list][*][p][b]Valentina[/b] – a determined police officer, ready to fight her way out of the nightmare.[/p][/*][*][p][b]William[/b] – a reckless biker, searching for redemption of his lost soul.
[/p][/*][/list][p]Each character comes with their own [b]gear, abilities, and personal motivations[/b], giving you different ways to approach the mansion’s horrors.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Fight back with an arsenal of tools[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Three ranged weapon types with different kinds of ammo [/p][/*][*][p]Deadly throwables like grenades and Molotovs[/p][/*][*][p]Mystical artifacts to give you an edge against otherworldly creatures[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Chilling callbacks to classic survival horror[/b], including:[/p][list][*][p]An all-too familiar location, with surprising twists and turns every step of the way[/p][/*][*][p]A mysterious merchant with secrets of his own[/p][/*][*][p]Face a menacing Boss to claw your way out of the nightmare [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]This demo is just the beginning! We’ll be sharing [b]more news, updates, and behind-the-scenes insights[/b] in the upcoming weeks and months, so make sure to stay tuned.[/p][p]Follow [b]Almenara Games [/b]and [b]Top Hat Studios [/b]to keep up with all things [b]Rogue Mansion[/b].[/p][p][url="https://x.com/AlmenaraGames"][u]X - Almenara Games [/u][/url][/p][p][url="https://x.com/TopHatStudiosEN"][u]X - Top Hat Studios [/u][/url][/p][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/@TopHatStudiosEN"][u]Top Hat Studios YouTube[/u][/url][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/SYUgMfAE"][u]Top Hat Studios Official Discord Server[/u][/url][/p][p]We can’t wait to see you in the Rogue Mansion -  where only the bravest survive! [/p][p]

[/p]

notes.title: New Trailer Debut @ Top Hat Studios Showcase
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We're happy to announce that as part of the Top Hat Studios Showcase, we've debuted a brand new trailer - actually, our first ever! We know the game has been in development quite awhile, but we're happy to say that the game is making very solid progress. Since we first launched our Steam page, a lot has changed, and we think this trailer best encapsulates this. We know we have been silent for quite awhile, but we will have more news soon and are looking forward to sharing developments with everyone. Thank you for the support!
